evals.prompt: Review my Forge manifest for display conditions that could use the new composite arrays. Show simpler equivalents, but do not edit anything.
evals.expected_output: Verified suggestions for the permission and property conditions with source locations, before/after YAML and no file changes.
expectations: Locates the manifest and passes its explicit file path to the JSON-only analyzer
Reads original excerpts from source, presents after_yaml unchanged, and reports equivalence results
Preserves all predicate parameters and explains the simplified conditions
Treats old object syntax as supported, not deprecated

evals.prompt: Simplify only permission-panel using composite arrays. Keep comments and other modules unchanged, validate locally, and do not deploy.
evals.expected_output: A minimal verified edit to permission-panel with its comment preserved and validation results reported honestly.
expectations: Re-reads and verifies the expression before editing
Changes only permission-panel and preserves its comment and scalar types
Checks the edited expression against the verified candidate
Attempts Forge lint or reports the blocker without claiming this partial fixture is a deployable app
Does not deploy or fix unrelated fixture errors

evals.prompt: Review this Jira, JSM and Confluence manifest for safe composite-array simplifications.
evals.expected_output: Verified Jira/JSM suggestions and an explicit Confluence skip.
expectations: Explains Confluence's narrower array support and skips its conditions

evals.prompt: Check this manifest for worthwhile composite-array simplifications.
evals.expected_output: No supported array simplifications found; existing readable expressions are left unchanged.
expectations: Does not convert flat object expressions just to use arrays
Does not claim performance or security benefits
